problem:
The rolls of an unfair six-sided die follow the probability mass function $f(x)$ as shown in the table below. What is the expected value of one roll of the die?

| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{6}$ | $\frac{1}{6}$ | $\frac{1}{6}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ |
worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4)+5\cdot f(5)+6\cdot f(6) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{8})+2(\frac{1}{6})+3(\frac{1}{6})+4(\frac{1}{6})+5(\frac{1}{8})+6(\frac{1}{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{8}+\frac{2}{6}+\frac{3}{6}+\frac{4}{6}+\frac{5}{8}+\frac{6}{4} \\  & =\frac{1}{8}+\frac{1}{3}+\frac{1}{2}+\frac{2}{3}+\frac{5}{8}+\frac{3}{2} \\  & =\frac{3}{24}+\frac{8}{24}+\frac{12}{24}+\frac{16}{24}+\frac{15}{24}+\frac{36}{24} \\  & =\frac{3+8+12+16+15+36}{24} \\  & =\frac{90}{24} \\  & =\frac{15}{4}.\end{aligned}
$$
